decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (CA/DO/01, CA/DO/02, CA/DO/03, CA/DO/04, CA/DO/05 received on 21/04/2015) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The development permitted by this planning permission shall only be undertaken as part of a concurrent building operation with that extension approved by planning permission ref. 00308/11/P2, and the extension hereby approved shall not be occupied until such time as the side extension has been substantially completed (walls and roof constructed).
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension
